propositions: Cross-subtree blocking links are silently escalated to nearest common ancestor endpoints, but the caller receives only 'ok' with no indication that different edges were recorded.
The redirect record is emitted to stdout but never returned, so library and MCP callers cannot observe the substitution even though the CLI can.
Five call-site layers in the propagation chain must return the redirect record: add_dependency, link_core, _link closure, _python_leaf, and rebar.link itself.
The quiet sink suppressing stdout must remain to protect MCP-over-stdio protocol integrity and other in-process callers; the defect is lack of a return value, not stdout suppression.
When escalation occurs, link_tickets must return a string reporting both the requested and resolved endpoints so the agent observes the substitution.
